title: Breaking: The Brood Is Back (Part 2)
description: We come back from the break with the brood's spokesman still on hold and still working through Mildred's banana. Rhonda translates the formants live while it negotiates terms, Ronnie keeps upgrading the situation, and somewhere between the rider and the demands it becomes clear the brood is not asking for airtime. It's asking for a slot.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: And we're back on Snazzie FM, still a guest, not an emergence. <p:0.3> The brood's spokesman has been holding through the whole break. Rhonda, is it still on the meter?

lines.speaker: rhonda
lines.text: It's on the meter, Ronnie. It hasn't moved. <p:0.3> For folks just joining, a million cicadas grew a throat, elected one big one, and that one learned the word airtime. <p:0.4> And now it's, okay, it's doing the formant again.

lines.speaker: brood-prime
lines.text: Helloooo. <p:0.4> Snazzie. <p:0.3> F. M.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: It said the call letters. <p:0.3> The bug said the call letters, Ronnie.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: It nailed the call letters, Barry. Cleaner than most of our interns. <p:0.3> Todd, no offense.

lines.speaker: todd
lines.text: Some offense taken, Ronnie.

lines.speaker: brood-prime
lines.text: Weee, would like, <p:0.3> a segment. <p:0.4> Driiive time. <p:0.3> And, more, <p:0.3> banaaana.

lines.speaker: rhonda
lines.text: It's negotiating, Ronnie. The vowels resolved into a clause. It wants drive time and it wants more banana, and those are connected. <p:0.4> It's bundling the banana into the deal.

lines.speaker: caller-mildred
lines.text: I've cut three more bananas, dear. <p:0.3> They formed a line at each one. Three lines. <p:0.3> It's a queue with branches now.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: An org chart. <p:0.3> Folks, that's a hierarchy. I'm upgrading us to a Tier Four Labor Action.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Labor action? They're insects, Ronnie. They want fruit.

lines.speaker: brood-prime
lines.text: Wee, are not, <p:0.3> insects. <p:0.4> Weee, are, <p:0.3> talent.

lines.speaker: caller-darnell
lines.text: Ronnie, my car's gone. <p:0.3> Not stolen, gone, they LIFTED it. A million bugs picked up a sedan and walked it toward the station like ants with a chip!

lines.speaker: rhonda
lines.text: They're moving the swarm to the transmitter, Ronnie. The downbeat's pointed at the tower now. <p:0.4> They don't want to be on the radio. They want to BE the radio.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Be the radio. <p:0.3> Rhonda, confirm the demand. What exactly is the spokesman asking for?

lines.speaker: brood-prime
lines.text: The, <p:0.3> nine, P. M. <p:0.3> slot.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: That's my slot. <p:0.3> That's literally my slot, Ronnie.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: It's a strong slot, Barry. <p:0.3> And they did bring their own audience.

lines.speaker: caller-mildred
lines.text: The bananas are gone, dear! <p:0.3> All of them! They ate the leverage!

lines.speaker: todd
lines.text: The big one finished Mildred's banana! <p:0.3> It set the peel down like a contract! It's tapping the peel!

lines.speaker: caller-darnell
lines.text: They're on the tower! They're ON the tower, Barry!

lines.speaker: rhonda
lines.text: It learned a third word! It said sponsor!

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Do NOT give the bugs a sponsor, Ronnie!

lines.speaker: brood-prime
lines.text: Banaaana, <p:0.3> Republic. <p:0.4> A word, <p:0.3> from our, <p:0.3> sponsor.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: It sold its own ad read. <p:0.4> Folks. <p:0.3> We are no longer classifying this as a guest, or a labor action. <p:0.3> We are classifying it as my replacement.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: I told you it was a calendar thing.

lines.speaker: rhonda
lines.text: It just learned a fourth word, Ronnie. <p:0.3> After sponsor. <p:0.4> It looked at the schedule, then it looked at you. <p:0.3> And it said, Barry.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Then we put it on hold one more time. <p:0.3> The nine P. M. slot is under review, the bugs have a sponsor, and Barry, soon as it learns to say fired, we'll be right back.
